segments.snp3.8:2.1: Na hi so upakkamo atthi, yena jātā na miyyare;
segments.snp3.8:2.3: Jarampi patvā maraṇaṃ, evaṃdhammā hi pāṇino.
segments.snp3.8:3.1: Phalānamiva pakkānaṃ, pāto patanato [papatato (sī. pī. aṭṭha.)] bhayaṃ;
segments.snp3.8:3.3: Evaṃ jātāna maccānaṃ, niccaṃ maraṇato bhayaṃ.
segments.snp3.8:5.1: Daharā ca mahantā ca, ye bālā ye ca paṇḍitā;
segments.snp3.8:6.3: Na pitā tāyate puttaṃ, ñātī vā pana ñātake.
segments.snp3.8:7.1: Pekkhataṃ yeva ñātīnaṃ, passa lālapataṃ puthu;
segments.snp3.8:8.1: Evamabbhāhato loko, maccunā ca jarāya ca;
segments.snp3.8:8.3: Tasmā dhīrā na socanti, viditvā lokapariyāyaṃ.
segments.snp3.8:9.1: Yassa maggaṃ na jānāsi, āgatassa gatassa vā;
segments.snp3.8:10.3: Sammūḷho hiṃsamattānaṃ, kayirā ce naṃ vicakkhaṇo.
segments.snp3.8:11.1: Na hi ruṇṇena sokena, santiṃ pappoti cetaso;
segments.snp3.8:12.3: Na tena petā pālenti, niratthā paridevanā.
segments.snp3.8:15.1: Yena yena hi maññanti, tato taṃ hoti aññathā;
segments.snp3.8:16.1: Api vassasataṃ jīve, bhiyyo vā pana māṇavo;
segments.snp3.8:16.3: Ñātisaṅghā vinā hoti, jahāti idha jīvitaṃ.
segments.snp3.8:17.3: Petaṃ kālaṅkataṃ disvā, neso labbhā mayā iti.
segments.snp3.8:18.3: Evampi dhīro sapañño, paṇḍito kusalo naro;

lines: Sallanti etameva tippakāraṃ dunnīharaṇaṭṭhena antovijjhanaṭṭhena ca sallaṃ.
Etasmiñhi abbūḷhe salle abbūḷhasallo … pe … nibbutoti arahattanikūṭena desanaṃ niṭṭhāpesi.
Sesaṃ idha ito pubbe vuttattā uttānatthameva, tasmā na vaṇṇitaṃ.
